components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The committing or forward action in a control group.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 17px; color: #fff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent, #1464e8); font: 560 15px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #0e55cc; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(20, 100, 232, 0.45); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-button-primary { background: #286edc; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #347bea; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline-color: rgba(121, 173, 255, 0.62); } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered read, cancel, or supporting action.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 17px; color: var(--text, #15171b); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #cfd5dd); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #fff); font: 560 15px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: #b9c0c9; background: #f5f6f8; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(20, 100, 232, 0.45); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-button-secondary { color: #f2f4f7; border-color: #3a414d; background: #171a20; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: #525a67; background: #22262e; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline-color: rgba(121, 173, 255, 0.62); } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A compact field for names, identifiers, filters, and metadata.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #30353c; font: 620 11px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 11px; color: var(--text, #15171b); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #cfd5dd); border-radius: 7px; outline: 0; background: var(--surface, #fff); font: 400 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #1464e8); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(20, 100, 232, 0.1); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-field { color: #d1d6dd; } .ds-field input { color: #f2f4f7; border-color: #3a414d; background: #171a20; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #79adff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(121, 173, 255, 0.15); } }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The current workspace destination in the primary rail.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 49px; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 0 17px; color: #075cde; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--accent-soft, #ebf3ff); font: 620 16px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 21px; height: 21px; fill: none; stroke: var(--accent, #1464e8); stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #e2edff; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(20, 100, 232, 0.45); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-nav-item { color: #79adff; background: #182b48; } .ds-nav-item svg { stroke: #79adff; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #20385c; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline-color: rgba(121, 173, 255, 0.62); } }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A compact switch between a small set of peer views.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; height: 45px; align-items: center; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #cfd5dd); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-segmented button { height: 37px; padding: 0 17px; color: var(--text, #15171b); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; font: 400 14px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-segmented button:hover { background: #f4f5f7; } .ds-segmented button.ds-active { color: #075cde; background: var(--accent-soft, #ebf3ff); font-weight: 600; } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(20, 100, 232, 0.45); outline-offset: 1px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-segmented { border-color: #3a414d; background: #171a20; } .ds-segmented button { color: #f2f4f7; } .ds-segmented button:hover { background: #22262e; } .ds-segmented button.ds-active { color: #79adff; background: #182b48; } }

components.name: Semantic Status Labels
components.description: Text-backed status colors for success, warning, and danger.
components.html: ReadyNeeds reviewBlocked
components.css: .ds-status-set { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; color: var(--text, #15171b); font: 400 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status i { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: #8b919c; } .ds-status.ds-success i { background: var(--success, #42a348); } .ds-status.ds-warning i { background: var(--warning, #e69512); } .ds-status.ds-danger i { background: var(--danger, #d84444); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-status-set { color: #f2f4f7; } .ds-status.ds-success i { background: #65c970; } .ds-status.ds-warning i { background: #eeb245; } .ds-status.ds-danger i { background: #ff747c; } }

components.name: Operational Panel
components.description: A flat, bordered container for compact operating rows.
components.css: .ds-panel { overflow: hidden; color: var(--text, #15171b); border: 1px solid var(--border, #dfe3e8); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #fff); font: 400 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-panel header { display: flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #dfe3e8); } .ds-panel header strong { font-size: 15px; } .ds-panel dl { margin: 0; padding: 0 16px; } .ds-panel dl div { display: grid; min-height: 42px; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #dfe3e8); } .ds-panel dl div:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-panel dt { color: var(--muted, #656b76); } .ds-panel dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 560; } .ds-panel .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-size: 12px; } .ds-panel .ds-status i { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--success, #42a348); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-panel { color: #f2f4f7; border-color: #2a2f38; background: #171a20; } .ds-panel header, .ds-panel dl div { border-color: #2a2f38; } .ds-panel dt { color: #a6adb8; } .ds-panel .ds-status i { background: #65c970; } }

components.name: Compact Table
components.description: A hairline-separated table with quiet headers and blue selection.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border, #dfe3e8); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; color: var(--text, #15171b); font: 400 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-table th { height: 42px; padding: 0 14px; color: #3e444d; background: #fff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 550; text-align: left; } .ds-table td { height: 46px; padding: 0 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #dfe3e8); } .ds-table tbody tr { background: var(--surface, #fff); transition: background-color 100ms ease; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #f7f9fc; } .ds-table tbody tr.ds-selected { background: #eff5ff; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent, #1464e8); } .ds-ready { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; } .ds-ready i { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--success, #42a348); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-table-wrap { border-color: #2a2f38; background: #171a20; } .ds-table { color: #f2f4f7; } .ds-table th { color: #cbd0d8; background: #191c22; } .ds-table td { border-color: #2a2f38; } .ds-table tbody tr { background: #171a20; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #1d222a; } .ds-table tbody tr.ds-selected { background: #172945; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #79adff; } .ds-ready i { background: #65c970; } }

components.name: Review Dialog
components.description: The elevated layer for reviewing an exact decision before confirmation.
components.html:
Review changes

Confirm the exact values before applying.

One change is ready for review.
components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(540px, 100%); overflow: hidden; color: var(--text, #15171b); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(24, 31, 42, 0.2); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-dialog header { padding: 23px 24px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #dfe3e8); } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-dialog p { margin: 7px 0 0; color: var(--muted, #656b76); font-size: 13px; } .ds-dialog-content { padding: 22px 24px; font-size: 13px; } .ds-dialog footer { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 9px; padding: 16px 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #dfe3e8); background: #fafbfc; } .ds-dialog button { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 15px; border-radius: 8px; font: 560 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-dialog button:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-dialog button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(20, 100, 232, 0.45); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-cancel { color: var(--text, #15171b); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #cfd5dd); background: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-confirm { color: #fff; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--accent, #1464e8); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-dialog { color: #f2f4f7; border-color: #3a414d; background: #191c22; box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55); } .ds-dialog header, .ds-dialog footer { border-color: #2a2f38; } .ds-dialog p { color: #a6adb8; } .ds-dialog footer { background: #1e2229; } .ds-cancel { color: #f2f4f7; border-color: #3a414d; background: #171a20; } .ds-confirm { background: #286edc; } .ds-dialog button:focus-visible { outline-color: rgba(121, 173, 255, 0.62); } }

narrative.overview:
The Calm Operations Console treats ASC Studio as a working instrument: information leads, framing recedes, and the interface stays legible under operational density. Light and dark themes use paired neutrals, hairlines, and blue selection to make current context obvious without turning status into decoration.

The system is precise, calm, and operational. Persistent surfaces stay flat; compact tables and rows carry most workflow state; semantic color marks real status only. Identity comes from consistency in spacing, type, and interaction restraint.
keyCharacteristics: Paired light and dark theme roles.
Blue for action, focus, selection, and in-progress state.
Semantic dots and labels for success, warning, and danger.
Flat persistent surfaces divided by thin hairlines.
Compact system typography, controls, tables, and rows.

rules.name: The Theme Pair Rule
rules.body: Choose every role from one theme set; never combine daylight and night tokens on the same surface.

rules.name: The One Semantic Meaning Rule
rules.body: Blue indicates action, focus, selection, or progress; green means ready or successful; amber means attention; red means blocked, failed, or destructive. Pair semantic color with text rather than relying on color alone.

rules.name: The Scan First Rule
rules.body: Keep headings short, labels compact, and values visually firmer than their descriptors so a workspace reads in vertical and tabular passes.

rules.name: The Preserve Context Rule
rules.body: Collapse navigation chrome and secondary labels before removing the status, scope, or units that make operational data trustworthy.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If a surface persists in the workspace, separate it with tone and a hairline; reserve elevation for dialogs.

rules.name: The Tight Radius Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary controls and panels within the established 7–9px range; use the larger overlay radius only for dialogs.

dos: Do choose the complete light or dark token set before styling a surface.
Do reserve blue for actions, focus, selection, and in-progress state.
Do pair every semantic dot or color with a text label.
Do use one-pixel hairlines and compact rows to organize operational data.
Do preserve the 1220px, 820px, and 620px responsive behaviors when extending the shell.
Do keep motion to short state changes in transform, opacity, background, or border.
donts: Don't add shadows to persistent panels, tables, or docks.
Don't mix light-theme and dark-theme token roles on the same surface.
Don't replace factual status language with decorative scores, trends, or visual claims.
Don't enlarge controls or spacing until the operating density stops reading as a desktop tool.
Don't animate layout for decoration or ignore reduced-motion preferences.
